claim_text: This generation raised up one more time in a revival greater than Pensacola and greater than Azusa Street, with many Azusa Streets throughout the nation, Canada, Asia, Europe, Africa, South America and the Middle East, not a little light but an inferno.
quote: ONE MORE REVIVAL GREATER THAN WHAT HAPPENED AT PENSACOLA
falsify_match: A revival exceeding the Brownsville and Azusa Street movements.
falsify_miss: None. Both are documented movements, which makes them usable benchmarks.

claim_text: Thanks for the decisions made for Iran that day, that the people of Iran and Cuba are liberated and God will use him like David to bring the gospel into areas closed to it, with the glorious gospel preached in North Korea, Taiwan and Pakistan.
quote: We will have the glorious gospel preached in North Korea
falsify_match: Open preaching in North Korea.
falsify_miss: None. North Korea is the clean test, since nothing there could be missed if it happened.

claim_text: The blood pleaded and the angels of the Lord over their brothers and sisters in Nigeria whose cries for help have not been ignored, with angelic aid and assistance called through Nigeria and into Iran.
quote: the angels of the Lord are over our brothers and sisters in Nigeria
falsify_match: A reduction in attacks on Nigerian Christians.
falsify_miss: Attacks continue. Killings in Nigeria have run in the thousands a year, which is the base rate.

claim_text: The stronghold over Minnesota broken and the named congresswoman removed, replaced by men and women of integrity, with Sharia law not over this nation or in any city, and a shaking called over New York, New Jersey and Chicago.
quote: Omar will be removed
falsify_match: That congresswoman leaving office.
falsify_miss: She does not. This is the earliest telling of her removal.

claim_text: Sharia law will not be in any of these areas, not even in Houston, because this is not a Muslim nation but a Christian one, and the same over Canada where a major revival breaks forth and the prime minister is removed by votes, with a shaking coming over British Columbia and Alberta becoming part of America one day.
quote: It's not a Muslim nation. This is a Christian nation
falsify_match: No adoption of religious law in American cities.
falsify_miss: Adoption occurs. It sits against his own tribulation material about compulsory Friday worship.

claim_text: He works out on air whether it is Ontario or Alberta, names British Columbia and says he is calling all of it, adding that Canada has not done a good job by them, and asks for whatever it takes to bring revival to Canada.
quote: British Columbia. I'm calling all of it
falsify_match: A Canadian province joining the United States.
falsify_miss: None does. A provincial accession would be one of the most visible political events imaginable.

claim_text: There were layers to it and they are only touching the thin ones, because the corruption in California is rice paper thin at the surface and goes far deeper, the same in Minnesota and over Pennsylvania, Boston, Seattle and Portland, like a layer of swamps in the politics and government.
quote: It's like a layer of swamps
falsify_match: Corruption findings far exceeding what has been disclosed.
falsify_miss: None. Saying only the thin layer is visible means any absence of findings is expected.

claim_text: Seed time and harvest coming to full fruit so that whatever a man sows he also reaps, with no more holding back and the full manifestation of the judgment concerning the California governor and the corruption there, and a great revival taking place in California.
quote: there's no more holding it back concerning Gavin
falsify_match: Legal or political consequences falling on the California governor.
falsify_miss: None. His term ends in January 2027 either way.

claim_text: Revival called in Portland, Seattle, Las Vegas and across the blue and red states, because the greater the blue the greater the harvest, and in Hawaii, Honolulu and Maui, with the Chinese leader removed and the tyrant government shaken as the iron curtain comes down.
quote: The greater the blue, the greater the harvest
falsify_match: Church growth concentrated in the most secular American cities.
falsify_miss: Growth stays where it is. The rule puts his expectation where the base rate is lowest.

claim_text: A shaking called in China's government, military, political structure and judges, with their government brought down and a shaking in the nation so that the spirit of God spreads like fire through that land and the greatest harvest invades Asia.
quote: I call their government to come down
falsify_match: The fall of the Chinese government.
falsify_miss: It stands. He says himself he does not know how their government works.

claim_text: The volcano off the coast of Oregon is rumbling under the water as they speak and the ground is beginning to shake, with a major sign about to take place, a shaking of the earth's crust and the ring of fire and of Japan, and major earthquakes in which temples a thousand years old in India are shaken to the ground in seconds.
quote: Temples that were a thousand years old will be shaken to the ground
falsify_match: Submarine eruption off Oregon, or ancient Indian temples destroyed by quakes.
falsify_miss: Neither. Rumbling right now is dateable and would show on seismic records.

claim_text: Great financial stability coming to Israel after Jerusalem, a blessing that provokes many nations and those upset about it, with an exceeding greatness on that generation and the Abrahamic blessing shown, no replacement theology, and a re-establishing of the covenant and the favour that will be seen by the nations.
quote: There's no replacement theology
falsify_match: A visible surge in Israeli prosperity read internationally as covenant blessing.
falsify_miss: None. Provoking the nations is not tied to anything measurable.

claim_text: He says he is done with replacement theology and is shaking it so that people will have to turn their heads deliberately to miss it, that those who bless will be blessed and those who curse cursed, with a covenant extended like a cord to the nations that bless his land, bringing life and multiplication when it is plugged in.
quote: I am done with the replacement theology
falsify_match: Nations visibly prospering after backing Israel.
falsify_miss: None. The blessing is conditional on blessing the land, which explains any absence.

claim_text: Turmoil in Iran with something like nuclear waste coming up out of the land, black vapour lines rising out of Iran and out of the Muslim nations trying to annihilate Israel including Turkey, looking like hazardous waste, with their very land drying up and the root of the plant drying with it.
quote: I see black vapor lines coming up out of Iran
falsify_match: Agricultural collapse or contamination across Iran and Turkey.
falsify_miss: None. Crop and water data would settle the drying up part.

claim_text: He heard it very clearly and saw the blessing all over him: if the president is smart he will line up this way, with a three-stranded cord not easily broken extended, and as he blessed the land blessing came back and sustained even more blessing on America.
quote: If your president is smart, he will line up this way
falsify_match: American prosperity following support for Israel.
falsify_miss: None. The condition means a downturn can be read as him not lining up.

claim_text: Antisemitism rises to an all-time high around the world as Israel strikes against Iran, and the Jews come back to the land in record numbers because of it, which he says is God's hand bringing his people back by pressure on the olive, uprooting those who have been rooted in certain areas.
quote: the Jews will come back to the land at record numbers
falsify_match: Record immigration to Israel.
falsify_miss: None. Aliyah figures are published annually, so record numbers is directly checkable.

claim_text: Fires in cities and fires in New York where there is a great Jewish community, with a lot of protesting, cars on fire, picketing and people angry at the Jews, marching in hoodies and heavy coats.
quote: people were upset at the Jew at the Jews
falsify_match: Antisemitic rioting with arson in New York.
falsify_miss: None. Protests have occurred without the fires, which is the part that would have to be met.

claim_text: He notes the different broadcast time and asks where people are watching from, with viewers in Germany and Europe where it is evening.
quote: Do you all like this new time?
falsify_match: Nothing. Housekeeping.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No claim is made.

claim_text: It is similar to the Hitler time and hostile, and he says he does not mean a holocaust but the thinking, an anti-Israel and anti-Jewish mindset like a sickness, in major cities across Europe and America.
quote: It's it's the thinking. It's like a sickness
falsify_match: A measurable rise in antisemitic attitudes in those cities.
falsify_miss: A fall. He explicitly narrows it from violence to attitude, which makes it harder to score.

claim_text: Blocking the bombardment of missiles and drones so that every one falls into the sea and none touches them, so that they say only the hand of the Lord protected them, and that the skyscrapers in New York, the rioting and the things he has seen coming would not happen.
quote: the things that I've seen coming, Father, would not happen
falsify_match: No attack on New York and no missiles reaching their targets.
falsify_miss: Either occurs. He asks for the opposite of the word he has been giving, which is the recurring pattern.

claim_text: Proclaiming Jesus in the workplace, the household and over America and Australia, with the glorious church rising in authority and power and not in retreat mode but taking the land, looking up because redemption draws near.
quote: we're not in retreat mode. We're in taking the land mode
falsify_match: Nothing. Exhortation.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Revival again across America with great tents, and where there are sporting events there will be glory events instead, with stadiums full of the glory of God, and authority taken over a named virus.
quote: WE WILL HAVE GLORY events instead of just sporting events
falsify_match: Stadiums filled for religious meetings rather than sport.
falsify_miss: None. Instead of is the strong form, and would be unmistakable if met.

claim_text: What is being done to the Iranian people is like a genocide that is not being exposed, and he prays for the underground church there and a major revival, recalling that the Lord has shown many times that he was bringing liberation, and that the Lord told him that morning he had grabbed hold of a word by faith.
quote: It takes faith to believe that
falsify_match: Liberation and open church growth in Iran.
falsify_miss: Neither. Taking it by faith is offered as the reason the absence of fruit does not count.

claim_text: He says he does not question anything God says to him but simply believes it and is fully persuaded once something of that magnitude is spoken, even though there is no fruit of it, and notes this word was given over a year ago.
quote: I know that it's coming to pass, but there's no fruit of it
falsify_match: The word eventually landing.
falsify_miss: It does not. He concedes here that a word given over a year ago has produced no fruit, which is the honest note against his own standard.

claim_text: The Lord said he is bringing liberation and a major revival to Iran, and that there would be things underground and archaeological discoveries that come up out of the ground and shake the Muslim community, and separately that he would have a million subscribers and a million women in a prayer army.
quote: archeological discoveries in the days ahead that will come up out of the ground
falsify_match: A discovery that visibly unsettles Muslim opinion, or a million subscribers.
falsify_miss: Neither. Both are countable, which is unusual for this material.

claim_text: It is a genetically modified AI virus that spreads through animals, and he says it goes through rats and will go through rats all through Europe because they will release it into rats, which his son has drawn as a cartoon warning.
quote: It will go through rats all through Europe
falsify_match: A rodent-borne epidemic across Europe.
falsify_miss: None. He calls it an AI virus, which is his own framing rather than a described mechanism.

claim_text: The underground chatter will be found, from Red Dawn experiences to Pearl Harbor experiences to a D-Day experience out of Cuba, and he says to watch Cuba for a D-Day because the old alliances from the Cuban missile crisis are coming back alive on a greater scale, seen in Cuba in the middle of the night.
quote: Watch Cuba for a D-Day
falsify_match: A coordinated attack on America launched from Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Three separate historical comparisons are stacked here, all of them unmistakable if met.

claim_text: Many small events rather than one of the same magnitude as September 11th, assignments that cripple the nation's infrastructure, with hotels and Chicago lit up very strongly, a hotel on the waterfront next to the river holding a plot with a device in it, and a New York skyscraper on the forty first floor.
quote: this is a plot of a device in the hotel
falsify_match: A device found or detonated at a riverside Chicago hotel.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling, and the riverfront placement narrows it to a handful of hotels.

claim_text: He and his son work out that it is the East River, with the building on that side, and he sees an explosion on the forty first floor with the numbers before his eyes, and says Chicago is highlighted bigger and more dominant than New York.
quote: It's an explosion on the 41st floor. Very clear
falsify_match: An explosion on that floor of a building by the East River.
falsify_miss: None. The floor number is the most specific detail in the American terror material.

claim_text: It goes from there to Japan where the same thing is connected, and from Japan to China, very dominant, with Asian men wearing masks with long noses in an underground network.
quote: they have long noses on their mask
falsify_match: A network of that kind exposed running between Japan and China.
falsify_miss: None. The masks are the identifying detail and would be recognisable.

claim_text: An outcry and uprising within the people almost like civil war when they realise they have been played, with too many people in million man marches demanding change in the government, spreading into Australia, Canada and Mexico.
quote: It's almost like civil war when they realize they've been played
falsify_match: Mass protests of that size demanding governmental change.
falsify_miss: None. He compares it to protests already happening, which weakens the threshold.

claim_text: He says he does not want to say too much about a decision that will be made, and asks for prayer over the safety of the servicemen and women who are somebody's children and need boldness without fear.
quote: I don't want to say too much for a decision that will be made
falsify_match: Nothing. He withholds the content.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Prayer over homeland security and over the hotels in Chicago and New York and everything he can talk about so far, and over the people who will be staying and sleeping in those buildings that night, and over the firefighters and first responders.
quote: there'll be people staying in those buildings and wanting to sleep
falsify_match: An incident at a hotel in either city.
falsify_miss: None. He says only part of what he sees can be talked about.

claim_text: He gives a shout-out to a named minister's grandson launching a church in Montecito, California the following night at a named beachfront hotel, saying the family are seers who flow with the gifts and that California needs a church like it.
quote: it's going to be at the Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Hotel
falsify_match: The launch takes place as described.
falsify_miss: It does not. An announcement rather than a word.

claim_text: They prayed for disruption in the way they do things so that the distraction would open a window for the underground church and a major revival in China and all of Asia, and it was about the Chinese leader, and within a twenty four hour period it is already in the news, in turmoil and raising questions about Taiwan, with generals involved.
quote: Within a 24-hour period, we're already seeing stuff in the news
falsify_match: Confirmed turmoil around the Chinese leadership.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling of the trouble around the Chinese leader.

claim_text: He is told to pray for a named senator's colon and his liver, the same thing they had seen before, going into this time frame, and then that for the president it is not just about Greenland but about how he handles God's land, Israel and the Gaza question.
quote: Pray for his colon. Pray for his liver, Ted Cruz
falsify_match: A disclosed illness of that kind in the named senator.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Naming two organs of a living public figure makes this checkable.

claim_text: Bringing the Palestinian Authority in to give counsel with a billion dollar seat, and how they handle the land of Israel is the deciding factor of his presidency, with the counsel coming from his son-in-law and the vice president, which the Lord calls a make or break concerning his presidency and term.
quote: This is the deciding factor of his presidency
falsify_match: A decisive break either way over the land.
falsify_miss: None. Make or break is not tied to any measurable outcome.

claim_text: There will be mass migration of Christians in the days ahead because great revival comes where there is great prayer, which is why it was in Tennessee and around a named pastor's church in Alabama, since revival begins with prayer and everything is cultivated with prayer.
quote: you'll see mass migration of Christians in the days ahead
falsify_match: Measurable religious migration toward those places.
falsify_miss: None. Migration data would settle it, and the named places are specific.

claim_text: He is standing at the door and many are not ready for what is about to take place in America and the countries around the world, so it matters to have a relationship with Jesus, and he says he is nothing special and simply decided to follow him.
quote: so many people that are not ready for what's about to take place
falsify_match: Nothing. Exhortation.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Lifting up the president, his cabinet and the Chinese leader, asking that the leader be removed and a new one raised up in China, with a major harvest in the underground church in China and throughout North and South Korea, the Philippines, Japan, Thailand, Vietnam, Nepal, India, Pakistan and Afghanistan.
quote: you would remove pain and you would raise up a new leader in China
falsify_match: A change of Chinese leadership.
falsify_miss: None. Naming eleven countries at once makes a partial claim of revival likely somewhere.

claim_text: As the seasons change, the winter season is over and a new spring is springing forth out of what seemed dormant, and the Lord says it is not just a window but that a door of opportunity is coming to some of them, with the daffodils bowing before him as he beat his drum through Europe.
quote: it's not just a window. A door of opportunity is coming
falsify_match: A lasting change rather than a brief one.
falsify_miss: None. He applies the window and door distinction to his audience's circumstances here.

claim_text: Praying over the Olympics for no terrorist attacks or plots and a covering over the Gaza deal and the covenant of many, and then the third temple: a temple will be built and they will discuss building it in the days ahead, which will be heard in the news and negotiated further by the Saudi crown prince.
quote: a temple will be built in the days ahead
falsify_match: Public negotiation over building a temple in Jerusalem.
falsify_miss: None. Discussion rather than construction is the lower bar he sets here.

claim_text: He says the Lord told him it is not about seeing but about praying over what he sees, that he does not want to be corrected after the broadcast for not doing his job properly, and that Gaza is highlighted big before him concerning the decisions to be made about the land of Israel.
quote: It's not about seeing. It's about praying over what you're seeing
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement about his own assignment.
falsify_miss: Nothing. It also means the value of a word does not rest on whether it lands.

claim_text: All the land of that area belongs to Israel and Gaza belongs to God, who says it is not Palestinian land but his land and Israel is the rightful heir and he is taking it back, and that how the land is handled in the decisions ahead is a very serious issue.
quote: He said it's not Palestinian land. He said this is my land
falsify_match: Israeli sovereignty established over Gaza.
falsify_miss: A Palestinian state is recognised there. He says plainly that people need not agree with him.

claim_text: A surprise attack coming from Iran which is weak but all they have, from a desperate situation and ready to do something desperate, a megaton, a round circle, with the Iranian leadership trying to work out how to retaliate for what is about to happen in their land, but it will come to nothing because he will squash it.
quote: This is a megaton like it's something bad
falsify_match: A large Iranian retaliatory strike.
falsify_miss: None. He describes the attack and says in the same breath that it will be void.
